reading_note: The teaching contrasts the celestial origin of love with the infernal origin of hatred. Love is the conjoining bond of the Divine — the Father's own being extended over all things, by which the Grand Man becomes one body with its members and gains victory. Hatred is the first spiritual death, erupting from the ground of self-love (Darkness): it destroys even its own offspring and assaults what is not its own, producing the genealogy of evil — hatred begetting envy, envy the devil, the devil the wicked one. The arc moves from the divine unity of love to the disintegrating cascade of self-love's progeny.
